cases.title: A context member principal admits a caller who shares a context instance with the record's named user
A caller who is in a context, but not the record owner's, is denied
A caller who belongs to no context at all resolves an empty roster and is denied rather than unrestricted
The record's own owner still reads it through the owner rule, with no membership anywhere
A caller reaching a context only through a grant is not a member of it and is denied a member's record
A member is likewise denied a grant-holder's record, because a grant puts nobody on the roster
Search returns only the records the roster admits, because the principal is applied per record on read
A context member principal granting the object-level search action is refused at compile time, because the search check has no record for the principal to read a context roster from
